name: Shanghai Maid Monogatari
source:
Our guy's father's will orders him to train 5 maids under his secretary's supervision. He has to work them day and night. All 5 maids love him, but will he be able to forget his lost lover (a maid shot in a street riot) and love them back?

[Edited from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403171040/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wns.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
主人公父亲的遗嘱要求他在秘书的监督下调教5名女仆。他必须日夜不停地训练她们。5名女仆都爱着他，但他能否忘记失去的恋人（在街头骚乱中被枪杀的女仆）并回报她们的爱呢？

[编辑自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403171040/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wns.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
